correctness.rationale: Signed-coordinate action is D8, acting as poset automorphisms on the Boolean lattice of sixteen teams. A finite quotient-poset lemma and the min/max antichain bijection are proved. Exhaustive direct interval-family enumeration over 65,536 masks and an independently structured 168-antichain compatible-pair enumeration agree: 3,938 families; signed fixed counts 3,938,526,526,186,186,186,26,26; Burnside 700, orbit sizes 26/54/289/331; full S4 Burnside 349. Reproduction scripts contain all finite domains, interval tests and assertions. No unbounded-case claim is made.

value.rationale: Recently established convex team logic provides a natural class of semantics whose literal-renaming quotient is not determined by expressive completeness or the labeled census. Two atoms give the first arity where the signed-literal action D8 is strictly smaller than arbitrary semantic S4 reindexing. Exact orbit and stabilizer data form a complete natural finite classification relevant to formula-normalization and benchmark reduction, with two independently reproducible enumeration methods.
